name: Svenja Hahn - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT containing a motion for a non-legislative resolution on the proposal for a Council decision on the conclusion of the Agreement on Digital Trade between the European Union and the Republic of Singapore
part_text:
The European Parliament gives its opinion on a new digital trade agreement between the EU and Singapore, signed in May 2025. The agreement sets common rules for online trade, electronic signatures and invoices, cross-border data flows, and protection of computer source code. Parliament welcomes it but asks the European Commission to make sure it does not weaken EU rules on privacy, data protection, consumer protection and artificial intelligence, and to check this after the agreement starts applying.

- **What changes:** New EU-Singapore rules on online trade, data flows and source code protection.
- **Who it affects:** Consumers, businesses and small companies trading online between the EU and Singapore.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must report to Parliament on how the agreement works in practice.
